nodes.label: Auntie Stella Character
nodes.rationale: Warm auntie mascot/guide: Black woman with deep brown skin (#8D5A3B), dark top-knot bun and swept hair, round wire glasses, rosy cheeks, small gold stud on one ear and a gold star dangle earring on the other (tying her to the Stellara star), pink top. Shared rig across all expressions; only brows, eyes, mouth and head tilt vary.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Expression Set
nodes.rationale: Emotion states (smiling, listening, proud, thinking) built from one parametric face so the guide can react to the user's state in-app.

nodes.label: Legacy Dusty-Blue Auntie Stella Palette
nodes.rationale: Earlier character palette: #D9E6F2 blue backdrop, #F4DCD5 peach top, #1E2B38 navy glasses, #F3D27A/#D9AE4E star earring, unoutlined flat shapes. Replaced in the standalone SVGs by the Sweet Garden palette.

nodes.label: Sweet Garden Palette
nodes.rationale: Current asset palette: mint #E1F2DB, blossom pink #F4A9C2 / #FCE1EA, sunny yellow #F6C445 with #D9A22C shading, leaf green #86BF7E / #2D6537, berry #C23A68, and a plum-brown #3A2430 ink outline on all shapes for a sticker-like look.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Expression Preview Sheet
nodes.rationale: HTML contact sheet laying out five inline 200px Auntie Stella SVGs (round smiling, listening, proud, smiling, thinking) on cream #FAF9F5 for side-by-side review. Its inline SVGs use an older palette (dusty-blue #D9E6F2 background, peach #F4DCD5 top, navy #1E2B38 glasses, no outlines) than the standalone SVG files, so the preview looks stale against the current Sweet Garden assets.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Round Avatar (Smiling)
nodes.rationale: Circle-cropped 240x240 bust of Auntie Stella smiling with open-mouth toothy grin, on mint #E1F2DB with confetti dots; intended as a round profile/avatar chip.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Listening
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square portrait; head tilted +4 degrees, open attentive eyes and a gentle closed-mouth smile, conveying attentive listening.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Proud
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square portrait; head lifted (translate -2, rotate -2), eyes closed in happy crescents and a broad closed smile, conveying pride in the user.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Smiling
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square default portrait: upright head, open eyes with catchlights, open-mouth grin showing teeth; the neutral-happy base expression.

nodes.label: Auntie Stella Thinking
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square portrait; head tilted -4 degrees, one brow raised, pupils glancing up and right, flat slightly lopsided mouth, conveying pondering.

nodes.label: Stellara App Icon
nodes.rationale: The star-and-sprout mark centered on a pale blossom-pink #FCE1EA rounded square (rx 30) with padding via expanded viewBox, sized for an app launcher icon.

nodes.label: Stellara Star Mark
nodes.rationale: Transparent 100x100 logo: a soft rounded yellow star with a smiling kawaii face and pink blush cheeks, topped by a sprout (two green leaves and a berry-pink bud) - a star that grows, merging 'stella' with garden growth.

nodes.label: Consent before child profile (FAM-02)
nodes.rationale: No child profile row exists without a consent record; required by NDPA.

nodes.label: Data location and cross-border transfer
nodes.rationale: No Supabase region in Nigeria, so DPIA must cover cross-border transfer under NDPA s.41-43.

nodes.label: Function-only Scoring Rule
nodes.rationale: Anything that scores, awards, issues tokens or touches answer keys goes through an Edge Function; RLS-safe reads go through PostgREST views

nodes.label: set-start
nodes.rationale: No answers or explanations returned so keys never reach the client for online sets

nodes.label: Answer Key Protection
nodes.rationale: Offline packs assumed extractable, so their items are kept out of test pools; keys never in online payloads

nodes.label: Child Runtime Rules
nodes.rationale: Never compute correctness for online sets on client; never block UI on network; partition data by child_id; no third-party scripts

nodes.label: Outbox Module
nodes.rationale: Queue, retry with backoff, idempotency, clock offset; answers saved to IndexedDB before any network call

nodes.label: responses-submit
nodes.rationale: Idempotent on client_id, batched up to 20 so the offline outbox can retry safely

nodes.label: Practice test blueprint
nodes.rationale: Blueprint is configuration not code; NCEE values are placeholders.

nodes.rationale: One codebase for all roles; largest local hiring pool.
